column1: # Carbon basis: edge weights are conserved carbon (kg C) recomputed from the flow volumes with the Phase G carbon model (config/carbon_densities.csv
column2: config/carbon_nodes.csv): every species enters at its raw density
column3: wood keeps its carbon through every node and the water edge Sawmills -> Shrinkage carries none. beta + pulp_share + energy_share + other_share = 1 per row. beta_literal uses the same conserved carbon.

column2: an absorbing Markov chain over the aggregated flows traces each species pool's harvest to its sinks with proportional mixing; T_i = max(inflow
column4: net imports and one-way inventory withdrawals are exogenous and never traced; an inventory that both receives and emits in a year is a pass-through whose net deposit goes to stock_change_share. beta = share absorbed at Long-term USE; pulp_share = Short-term USE; energy_share = Energy (near-immediate oxidation); other_share = exports + losses + shrinkage + stock change + closure gap. species=all is the harvest-carbon-weighted mean.

column1: # Gates applied to this export: a year is refused if any species' closure_gap exceeds 0.02
column2: or if a pool or process node emits more than it receives by over 0.15 of its outflow.

column2: but every downstream split is a fixed coefficient in constants.py; data/processed/beta_sensitivity.csv varies each one over config/coefficient_ranges.csv.
